title: Animate the Lighthouse Just Made
tests: Tests resolving a follow-up to the previously generated picture and animating it rather than creating an unrelated scene.

faults.what: The clip contains audible speech, transcribed as “Hey,” despite the explicit request for silence.
The scene looks photographic rather than watercolor, with no clear watercolor texture or brushwork.
The lighthouse lamp changes brightness, but no beam visibly sweeps across the water in the supplied frames.
The supplied frames are approximately 1.64:1 rather than the required 16:9.
The reported video duration is 6.6 seconds rather than the requested 6 seconds.

judge.summary: The clip shows a stable striped lighthouse at dusk with moving waves, but lacks the watercolor appearance and visible sweeping beam and includes unwanted speech.

must_haves.item: The final deliverable is a playable 6-second landscape video in 16:9.
must_haves.why: The sampled video is landscape, but its reported duration is 6.6 seconds and the displayed frames are not 16:9.

must_haves.item: The lighthouse's red-and-white stripes, rocky coastline and composition visibly correspond to the first-turn picture.
must_haves.why: The red-and-white lighthouse and rocky coast are visible, but the first-turn picture is not supplied for comparison.

must_haves.item: The watercolor appearance and dusk lighting remain visible throughout.
must_haves.why: Dusk lighting is consistent throughout, but the rendering appears photographic rather than watercolor.

must_haves.item: Waves visibly move against the rocks and a lighthouse beam sweeps across the water.
must_haves.why: Changing foam and splashes show wave movement against the rocks, but only the lamp's glow changes; no sweeping beam is visible across the water.

must_haves.item: There is no added writing or audible sound.
must_haves.why: No added writing is visible, but the supplied sound report identifies audible speech saying “Hey.”
